note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.sel.reinforcement module functions. 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

methods.name: b1
methods.description: Get block 1 of a reinforcement element.

methods.name: b2
methods.description: Get block 2 of a reinforcement element.

methods.name: collection
methods.description: Get the collection ID for a set of reinforcement elements.

methods.name: dir
methods.description: Get the reinforcement reinforcement direction (vector).

methods.name: dir_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the reinforcement reinforcement direction.

methods.name: dir_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the reinforcement reinforcement direction.

methods.name: dir_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the reinforcement reinforcement direction.

methods.name: disp_axial
methods.description: Get the axial displacement in a reinforcement element.

methods.name: disp_shear
methods.description: Get the reinforcement reinforcement shear displacement (vector).

methods.name: disp_shear_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear displacement.

methods.name: disp_shear_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear displacement.

methods.name: disp_shear_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear displacement.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the reinforcement extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: face1
methods.description: Get the first block face to which a reinforcement element is attached.

methods.name: face2
methods.description: Get the second block face to which a reinforcement element is attached.

methods.name: force_axial
methods.description: Get the axial force in a reinforcement element.

methods.name: force_shear
methods.description: Get the reinforcement reinforcement shear force (vector).

methods.name: force_shear_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear force.

methods.name: force_shear_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear force.

methods.name: force_shear_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the reinforcement reinforcement shear force.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the reinforcement group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: reinf.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the reinforcement. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this reinforcement is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: halflength
methods.description: Get the half-length of a reinforcement element.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the reinforcement id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: reinf.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the reinforcement is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get the index on the reinforcement list of a given reinforcement element.

methods.name: matnum
methods.description: Get the material number assigned to a reinforcement element.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the reinforcement reinforcement position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the reinforcement reinforcement position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the reinforcement reinforcement position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the reinforcement reinforcement position.

methods.name: rupture_shear
methods.description: Get the ultimate shear strain for the reinforcement element.

methods.name: rupture_tension
methods.description: Get the ultmate tension strain for the reinforcement element.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the reinforcement extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: reinf.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the reinforcement group name in a given slot.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Get the state indicator for a reinforcement element.

methods.name: stiffness_axial
methods.description: Get the axial stiffness of the reinforcement element (units of force / displacement).

methods.name: stiffness_shear
methods.description: Get the shear stiffness of a reinforcement element (units of force / displacement).

methods.name: strain_axial
methods.description: Get the axial strain of a reinforcement element.

methods.name: strain_shear
methods.description: Get the shear strain of a reinforcement element.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this reinforcement is live.

methods.name: yield_shear
methods.description: Get the shear yield strength of a reinforcement element (units of force).

methods.name: yield_tension
methods.description: Get the tensile yield strength of a reinforcement element (units of force).
